format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
movies <- read_csv("data/movies.csv")
```

```{r}
glimpse(movies)
names(movies)
```

```{r}
movies |>
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.x)))) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "column", values_to = "n_missing")
```

```{r}
movies |>
  filter(!is.na(boxOffice)) |>
  select(title, boxOffice) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
movies_clean <- movies |>
  separate_longer_delim(genre, delim = ", ") |>
  mutate(genre = str_trim(genre))
```

```{r}
movies_clean |>
  count(genre, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r}
movies |>
  summarise(
    mean_audience_score = mean(audienceScore, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_tomato_meter = mean(tomatoMeter, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
movies |>
  ggplot(aes(x = tomatoMeter)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, color = "white") +
  labs(
    x = "Tomatometer Score",
    y = "Count",
    title = "Distribution of Tomatometer Scores"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
movies_gap <- movies |>
  mutate(gap = tomatoMeter - audienceScore)

movies_gap
```

```{r}
gap_by_genre <- movies |>
  separate_longer_delim(genre, delim = ", ") |>
  mutate(genre = str_trim(genre)) |>
  mutate(gap = tomatoMeter - audienceScore) |>
  group_by(genre) |>
  summarise(
    mean_gap = mean(gap, na.rm = TRUE),
    movie_count = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(movie_count >= 50) |>
  arrange(mean_gap)

gap_by_genre
```

```{r}
movies_gap |>
  summarise(
    mean_gap = mean(gap, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_gap = median(gap, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_gap = sd(gap, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
movies_summary <- movies_gap |>
  separate_longer_delim(genre, delim = ", ") |>
  mutate(genre = str_trim(genre)) |>
  group_by(genre) |>
  summarise(
    mean_gap = mean(gap, na.rm = TRUE),
    movie_count = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(movie_count >= 100) |>
  arrange(mean_gap)

movies_summary
```

```{r}
movies_summary |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(genre, mean_gap), y = mean_gap)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Average critic-audience gap by genre",
    subtitle = "Positive values mean critics rate films more highly than audiences.",
    x = "Genre",
    y = "Average gap (Tomatometer - Audience score)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
